description.en: macOS only: turns the DSH conversation rail into a 12-band spectrum analyzer for whatever the Mac is playing. Bar length only; host state colours and lengths are preserved. Requires the Audio Recording permission on first run.
description.zh: macOS 专享：把 DSH 会话页右侧锚点变成 12 段真实频谱，跟着 Mac 播放的音乐律动。只改长度，保留宿主的状态颜色与长度。首次运行需授予「音频录制」权限。
